title: Colorful pots
description: allows you to recolor the designs of decorative pots using smithing materials
body:
![how the pots look ingame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0c44a1441a71722387f3bec180538aeede4f524.png)
Allows you to customize your pots using armor trim materials materials.
Use a smithing table to change a pot's appearance.

Currently usable smithing materials:
- diamond
- gold bar
- iron bar
- copper bar
- amethyst shard
- lapis lazuli
- resin brick (or orange dye if you are on a lower version)
- quartz
- ancient debris
- emerald
- redstone

If you have any suggestions, bug reports or feedback, feel free to create an issue on github: https://github.com/Fiverka21/colorful-pots
